title: PM Kisan 23rd Installment 2026 - Expected June-July, Complete eKYC Now to Avoid Payment Block
author: Ash K.
summary: PM Kisan 23rd installment expected in June-July 2026. 22nd installment of ₹18,640 crore credited to 9.32 crore farmers on March 13. Complete eKYC and verify bank-Aadhaar linking NOW to ensure your ₹2,000 is not blocked.
body: The PM Kisan 23rd installment is expected to be released in June-July 2026. The exact date has not been officially announced yet, but based on past patterns and the March 2026 release of the 22nd installment, the next payment is likely in late June or early July.

DetailInformation

Check Status Atpmkisan.gov.in → Beneficiary Status

What you must do RIGHT NOW: Complete your eKYC if you haven't already. Without eKYC, your 23rd installment will be automatically blocked regardless of when the government releases it. eKYC takes under 5 minutes.

How to complete eKYC: Option 1 - Download PMKISAN GoI app → Face Authentication eKYC → Enter Aadhaar → Scan face → Done. Option 2 - Visit pmkisan.gov.in → eKYC → Enter Aadhaar → OTP verification → Done. Option 3 - Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) if both app and portal don't work.

Check your 22nd installment status: Visit pmkisan.gov.in → Click 'Beneficiary Status' → Enter Aadhaar/mobile/account number → Check if 22nd installment (March 2026) was credited. If it shows 'pending' or 'failed', your bank details or Aadhaar linking has an issue.

Common reasons for payment failure: eKYC not completed. Name mismatch between Aadhaar and bank account. Bank account inactive or closed. Land records not verified by state government. Duplicate registration within the same family.

Who is NOT eligible: Institutional landholders, government employees (except Class IV/Group D), taxpayers, pensioners receiving ₹10,000+/month, practicing professionals (doctors, lawyers, CAs, engineers).

faqs.question: When will PM Kisan 23rd installment be released?
faqs.answer: The 23rd installment is expected in June-July 2026. The exact date will be announced on pmkisan.gov.in. The 22nd installment was released on March 13, 2026.

faqs.question: Is eKYC mandatory for PM Kisan 23rd installment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Without completing eKYC, your payment will be automatically blocked. Complete eKYC through the PMKISAN GoI app, pmkisan.gov.in, or your nearest CSC centre.

faqs.question: How to check PM Kisan 22nd installment status?
faqs.answer: Visit pmkisan.gov.in → Click 'Beneficiary Status' → Enter your Aadhaar number, mobile number, or account number → View payment history.

faqs.question: Why was my PM Kisan payment not received?
faqs.answer: Common reasons: eKYC not completed, name mismatch between Aadhaar and bank, inactive bank account, unverified land records, or duplicate family registration.

faqs.question: How much money is given under PM Kisan per year?
faqs.answer: ₹6,000 per year, paid in three installments of ₹2,000 each, directly to the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account through DBT.

callout.heading: Complete eKYC NOW
callout.content: Your PM Kisan 23rd installment will NOT be credited without eKYC. Download the PMKISAN GoI app → Face Authentication → Enter Aadhaar → Done in 5 minutes. Don't wait until the installment date - do it today.
